profileEvidence.summary: Willing to learn and keen to hunt, Münsterländers work in close contact with their handlers across field, woodland and water. The name covers two distinct breeds, the Large and Small Münsterländer. The Small brings a friendly, steady character and persistent tracking, pointing and retrieving instincts; the Large has a lively temperament without nervousness, especially valued for work after the shot.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Two distinct German gundog breeds, united by versatile field and water work, trainability and close cooperation with hunters.
